shortDescription: DCNM Ansible Module for managing vPC switch pairs required for vPC interfaces.

options.name: config
options.description: A list of dictionaries containing vPC switch pair information

options.name: deploy
options.description: Flag indicating if the configuration must be pushed to the switch.

options.name: src_fabric
options.description: Name of the target fabric for vPC switch pair operations

options.name: state
options.description: The required state of the configuration after module completion.

options.name: templates
options.description: List of templates to be fetched. This is required only if the 'state' is 'fetch'. In this case the list should contain the template names whose details. are to be fetched.
